title: Student Reinstatement Request & Return to Active Academic Standing

seedSql.query: INSERT INTO stu.lifecycle_status (tenant_id, student_id, status, effective_from, updated_at) VALUES ('a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', '81dd67d3-1d5f-4d8e-8061-a6764861f924', 'ON_LEAVE', now() - interval '60 days', now()) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, student_id) DO UPDATE SET status = 'ON_LEAVE', updated_at = now()

INSERT INTO stu.lifecycle_transition_rules (tenant_id, id, from_status, to_status, requires_approval, active) VALUES ('a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', '44444444-0004-0000-0000-000000000004', 'ON_LEAVE', 'ACTIVE', true, true) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, from_status, to_status) DO UPDATE SET active = true, requires_approval = true

steps.title: Portal Authentication
steps.description: Student on approved leave authenticates to CampXSync with authorized student session

steps.title: Navigate to Student Lifecycle Desk
steps.description: Verify student lifecycle workspace loads with verified ON_LEAVE academic standing badge

steps.title: Select Reinstatement Request Type
steps.description: Student selects 'Reinstatement (REINSTATE)' from request type dropdown to resume active studies

steps.title: Validation Error Guardrail
steps.description: Attempting submission with empty rationale triggers immediate validation alert banner

steps.title: Verify Validation Alert Banner
steps.description: System displays validation warning enforcing minimum 5-character clearance justification

steps.title: Provide Valid Medical Clearance Rationale
steps.description: Student enters detailed medical clearance rationale and return-to-campus readiness petition
steps.value: {{DEMO_TAG}} Medical clearance certificate issued following successful orthopaedic recovery. Requesting formal reinstatement to active academic standing.

steps.title: Submit Reinstatement Request
steps.description: Click 'Submit Request' button, dispatching POST /api/v1/lifecycle/requests through API Gateway to lifecycle-service

steps.title: Verify Submission Confirmation
steps.description: System displays immediate success banner confirming reinstatement petition is recorded and awaiting registrar review

steps.title: Switch to My Requests Tab
steps.description: Navigate to 'My Requests' tab to review submitted lifecycle petitions

steps.title: Verify Reinstatement Request Row and Status Badge
steps.description: Reinstatement petition is displayed live in requests table with PENDING status badge

steps.title: PostgreSQL Database Committed Check
steps.description: Read-only query verifies stu.lifecycle_requests has committed the request with type REINSTATE and status PENDING
steps.query: SELECT id, student_id, request_type, status, reason FROM stu.lifecycle_requests WHERE student_id = '81dd67d3-1d5f-4d8e-8061-a6764861f924' AND request_type = 'REINSTATE' AND reason LIKE '%{{DEMO_TAG}}%'

steps.title: Negative RBAC Enforcement Check
steps.description: Unauthenticated API request to gateway lifecycle endpoints must fail closed with HTTP 401 Unauthorized
